records.claim: The product label for verapamil recommends women who are breastfeeding not use this medication if breastfeeding. This is because there is not enough information on how the verapamil in breast milk might affect a nursing infant. But the benefits of using verapamil and breastfeeding might outweigh possible risks. Your healthcare providers can talk with you about using verapamil and what treatment is best for you. Be sure to talk to your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions.
